[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Cheyerooto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] bio-engineer who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Dr. Cheyerooto believes that he can treat the symptoms and cure the mad wookiee.|Sera Jossi, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SJ" />}}
Doctor Cheyerooto was a bio-engineer who gained some notoriety on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. However, at some point in his career, he returned to the Wookiee [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. He then resided in [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] and worked in the [[great tree]]'s medical center.<ref name="SWG:SJ" />

[[File:Crazy_Wookiee_village.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mad Wookiees in the abandoned village]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Cheyerooto and a friend, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] woman [[Sera Jossi]], were concerned about a strange new disease afflicting a number of Wookiees. The illness was marked by deteriorating health, giving rise to a madness which compelled the anguished Wookiees to attack anyone who approached them. Cheyerooto and Sera Jossi therefore intended to discover the cause of the disease that afflicted the Wookiees.<ref name="SWG:SJ" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the woman tasked a spacer with killing the Wookiee named [[Wrhisch]] and collecting his liver. Since the latter was one of the first to come under the sickness and was dying from the decay it caused, Doctor Cheyerooto thought that the liver could be used to identify the disease and develop a cure. The spacer explored an [[Abandoned Wookiee village|old abandoned village]] inhabited by the mad Wookiees, found the Wookiee Wrhisch, killed him and collected his liver. The adventurer later delivered Wrhisch's liver to Doctor Cheyerooto.<ref name="SWG:SJ" /> As expected, the organ from the afflicted Wookiee allowed the bio-engineer to start developing a treatment. However, the Wookiee needed to find [[rrwii]] roots to finalize the cure. Since this kind of root only grew in the [[Rodian Hunting Grounds|Etyyy region]] of Kashyyyk, the adventurer had first to get access to the area from the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] who took over the region. Finally, the spacer collected the plants and returned to Dr. Cheyerooto, allowing the Wookiee bio-engineer to finish the preparation of his treatment.<ref name="SWG:TRR">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|The Rrwii Root|Kashyyyk}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dr. Cheyerooto was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SJ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dr. Cheyerooto was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:SJ" />
